title: Moderating Discussions and Summarizing Positions
summary: Structuring group discussions, managing turns, and summarizing competing positions.
whyItMatters: Effective moderation makes goals, speaking turns, disagreement, and intermediate results visible without deciding the content for the group.

mentalModel.title: Process neutral, content accurate
mentalModel.content: Guide participation and structure while representing each position fairly.

mentalModel.title: Summaries are checkpoints
mentalModel.content: Periodically state agreements, disagreements, evidence needs, and the next question.

ruleBlocks.title: Set goal and procedure
ruleBlocks.content: Clarify the question, available time, speaking format, and expected outcome.

ruleBlocks.title: Manage participation actively
ruleBlocks.content: Invite quieter voices, limit repetition, and redirect interruptions.

ruleBlocks.title: Paraphrase before moving on
ruleBlocks.content: Check that speakers recognize the summary and separate shared ground from open issues.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Dazu würde ich gern noch ... hören.
Lassen Sie uns diesen Punkt kurz abschließen.
Damit kommen wir zur nächsten Frage.

examples.de: Unser Ziel ist, Chancen und Risiken hybrider Arbeit getrennt zu bewerten.
examples.en: Our goal is to evaluate the opportunities and risks of hybrid work separately.

examples.de: Wenn ich richtig zusammenfasse, besteht Einigkeit über Weiterbildung, aber nicht über die Finanzierung.
examples.en: If I summarize correctly, there is agreement on training but not on financing.

examples.de: Diesen Einwand halten wir fest und prüfen nun, welche Daten dafür vorliegen.
examples.en: We will record this objection and now examine what data supports it.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use moderation to promote your own position.
commonMistakes.correct: Mark personal contributions separately or remain process-neutral.
commonMistakes.reason: Participants need trust in fair facilitation.

commonMistakes.wrong: Move on without checking the summary.
commonMistakes.reason: A disputed summary creates later confusion.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies a complex issue with multiple legitimate perspectives.
Moderation often translates dense formal formulations into clear spoken clauses.
